body:
The first time marijuana was introduced to me was many years ago.  Which I enjoyed since than.  Adderall is something that has been recently introduced to me. One night me and a fellow friend decided to use some adderall that had been giving to us.  It was 25, 20 mg od Adderall XR, which is an extended release version of the over the counter drug.
I crushed two pills up one for my freind and one for me and snorted it.  I felt my eyes instantly water and my brain tingle.  A mighty undescribable feeling, but not close to the full effect of Adderall.  Next, me and Aaron head for the train tracks to smoke are two gram blunt, a 3 minute walk.  When I arrive at the train tracks we spark the blunt.  Before taking my first hits I feel like I could run down the train tracks at full speed.  I'm talking a mild a minute to Aaron.  My thoughts are endless.
The effect of the 20 mg's is in full effect.  My eyes feel like they're being held open..(like wen ur putting eye drops in)...They feel heavy.  My head feels very light, but my brain is a non stopping thinker.
The blunt is finally finished.  The effect of the marijuana makes me feel even more alert. In my mind it feels like I'm going insane, but this girl kate who picked me and Aaron up doesn;t even seem to notice.  I than have a instant urge to listen to some techno music.  I jus want to move, run, anyhting but sit still.
When I get home I eat anything do to the so called 'munchies' from the marijuana.  Suddenly my spped trip starts to come down.  I have the urge to snort another 20 mg pill.  My friend Aaron and I decide we will at 11:11 p.m.  When the time comes to we do so and again have the instant brain tingles.  It's amazing for the next few hours.
We listen to techno, playing videogames out of bordem, blow another line at 1:20 a.m., and all of the sudden it is 4:30 in the morning.  Time is with me so to speak when I am on adderall. My friends eventually falls alseep while I lay in bed still listening to my techno.  Nothing to do.  My brain thinks of everything to do, so I eat a bag of sun flower seeds.  When 7:00 a.m comes around my tongue is now numb from the salt and I could still run a marathon if I wanted to.  I decided to clean my room to keep me from becoming crazy. Aroud the same time I split a 20 mg pill into three lines and blow them every half hour.
When 9:00 comes around I am waiting for Aaron to wake up along with half of a twenty mg line waiting for us.  Then were of to work.  At wrok we blow another line(half a pill each) and work like slaves.  I felt like I was the hardest worker in the establishment.I honestly should have been voted employee of the week in my opinion.
The adderall was taking it's lst effects around 11:00 that night.  In all a 38 hour day, with no sleep at all and Adderall to thank.  The next few days I slept all day and felt like shit.  The negative part of the endless night drug, Adderall XR.
